question: Pandit S Ballesh Bhajantri is a _____________ artist.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• S Ballesh Bhajantri

 
 
• S. Ballesh Bhajantri is an Indian classical Hindustani Shehnai player.
 
• He plays often for Prasar Bharati's All India Radio (AIR) and Doordarshan.
 
• He was awarded India's fourth-highest civilian honor, the Padma Shri, in 2022.
 
• He was** bestowed the title of 'Dakshina Bharat Bismillah Khan" by Ustad Bismillah Khan himself.**
